Sanjay —

Thanks for the clear asks. High-level answers up front, then a checklist and a sample forwarder attached.

Quick answers:
- SIEM ingestion: We recommend a pull model to avoid direct outbound egress where possible — either an internal forwarder that writes encrypted bundles to a customer-managed S3 (signed-url short-lived objects) or a direct syslog over TLS into a customer collector in the VPC. If you must push, the forwarder should be in a private subnet with NAT disabled and talk to a restricted egress endpoint (VPC endpoint or proxy).
- Tracing hooks: Span generation should be done at the gateway layer where request metadata is first observed (request id, model id, route). Workers can emit detailed spans for token generation but without sampling at full QPS. We include precise headers and sampling suggestions in the checklist.

I've attached: redwood-onprem-obsv-checklist-v1.pdf (checklist + minimal footprint patterns) and forwarder-sample-config.yaml (example syslog/HTTPS forwarder config).

Notes on retention defaults: we suggest 7 days of full-fidelity logs at the model gateway, with aggregated metrics retained longer at the metrics tier. For customers with strict retention limits we supply baked-in truncation hooks and PII scrubbing filters.

Next steps: I can walk your infra team through the checklist tomorrow at 10am PT if that works.

Adding a couple of practical constraints we've seen in customer deployments to avoid surprises:

- Network ports: if you choose syslog/TLS, default port 6514 is typical; for HTTPS pulls push we use 443 and recommend mTLS to the collector. Documented firewall rule set is in the checklist.
- Disk & buffering: forwarders should cap local buffer to avoid OOM during spikes; we include a config option for max_buffer_mb (default 512MB) and time-based flush.
- Sampling strategy: gateway span rate (1 in 10 for high QPS), worker-level detailed spans on errors and 1 in 100 otherwise. Correlate with request_id to rehydrate full trace for sampled requests.

Sanjay — attaching an inline snippet from forwarder-sample-config.yaml for the HTTPS rollup option so your infra team can paste directly:

-----BEGIN FORWARDER SNIPPET-----
endpoint: https://collector.internal-finbank.svc
protocol: https
auth: mTLS
max_buffer_mb: 512
flush_interval_sec: 10
headers:
  - x-rw-request-id
  - x-rw-team
  - x-traceparent
-----END FORWARDER SNIPPET-----

I'll join the call if you want a short walkthrough.
